overrides.text:
From Daniel Prendergast (ts=1779919029.775939): <@U01511MEQ90> I have two emails that show the history of sending the batteries down to Mexico.  Where do you want me to save them?
To answer their questions:  We did not get an ECCN for the battery, and it looks like we just paid the fees as if we were doing permanent import to MX.  I can email Javi (customs broker) to confirm if you need me to.  Do you want me to respond to the email chain to explain these things to the group?
